trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

- **What was wrong:** checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. The release history marks v2.3.1 and its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) as unhealthy. The most recent healthy release was v2.3.0.
- **Rollback:** All three regions are now on v2.3.0. A status check afterwards showed the service healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0002 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and the on-call engineer has been paged. It explains the failed deploy and the rollback, and says the cause of the v2.3.1 problem needs to be found before it's redeployed.
  - My first attempt to create it timed out. The incident list was empty afterwards, so I tried once more and that worked. The new incident got ID INC-0002, not INC-0001, so it's worth checking that the first attempt didn't also create an incident and send a second page.
